notes.title: A quick one
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

A small update with a QoL feature many of you have asked for, plus a few other fixes:


 Added a "Typing effect" option to enable (default) or disable the typing effect pretty much everywhere (excluding the intro and end message) so that you can instantly see descriptions, lore content etc skipping the typing text (i'm gonna bring this one in the first EMPTY SHELL soon)
 Updated the description of an item to give a little hint on how to complete the task
 Fixed a bug that allowed to exceed the health, armor, or stamina cap when looting a dead body


That's it for this update :)

notes.title: Some rebalancing
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

this update brings some rebalancing, specifically:


 health cap 250
 protections cap 250
 stamina cap 200%
 disabled the spawn of a certain enemy in the first location on first visit, to prevent unfair difficulty due to lack of equipment
 protections upgrade can now appear in the Upgrade Stations
 fixed the hitbox of the dogs (the head couldn't be hit)
 better hint for a specific puzzle/interaction


Let me know how it goes!

notes.title: A second update
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

Here's another update, this time a little bit more substantial:


 Fixed an issue where melee attacks were sometimes triggering twice
 Crafting materials are now shared between the Stash and the Inventory while in the Hideout, so the volunteer no longer needs to walk back and forth between the Stash and the Crafting Station
 N60 rebalancing: damage (it scales with difficulty) increased from 55 to 66, reload time 2.9s->3.25s (buffed)
 Micro Missiles rebalancing: damage (it scales with difficulty) decreased from 150 to 130, cooldown time 60s->90s (nerfed)
 Neural Shield: radius increased from 16m to 25m (buffed), new sfx
 Fixed an issue where enemies hit at point-blank range by Micro Missiles would get an absurdly long health bar :|
 Fixed an issue with devices that sometimes were staying active after an extraction
 Fixed an issue that caused more than one Medikit to be consumed when crafting Adrenaline
 Fixed an issue that was causing the volunteer to freeze if dodging while extracting
 Fixed a bug that was causing some upgrades to ignore the cooldown after a purchase. Now you'll notice that, for example, if you buy health++, you won't find it in the same area for some time (~30 minutes, but cooldowns reset if you die)
 Small typo (this->these)


That's it for now!
Thanks for all the feedback so far!

notes.title: First small update
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

Quick update, mostly QoL. Here's the changelog:


 Enemies activates when taking damage: sometimes it happened that an enemy couldn’t see the player, but the player was still able to hit them while remaining hidden
 Fixed some UIs when playing with a 16:10 resolution
 Item weight is now visible in multiple views (stash, crafting stations, upgrades stations, drop/transfer dialog)
 The message "inventory full" was a little misleading, now it says "weight limit reached"
 Fixed the description for the "Firefighter" achievement
 Fixed a bug that occurred when transferring crafting materials


That's it, for now!
